notes.paper_confirmed: T=60; future T=20; H=M=32; GRU layers=2; tau=gamma=0.1; Adam lr=0.001; 100 epochs with early stopping set to 20 steps; paper uses seed 0. The validation criterion and epoch-based interpretation are replication choices.
notes.industry_substitution: User approved 134 SW2021 secondary industries. Static latest classification spans all dates and has future classification information; paper uses an unnamed 83-industry system.
notes.encoder_assumptions: GRU last-state BatchNorm, independent future encoder, unidirectional, bias=True, dropout=0, zero initial states.
notes.network_assumptions: One symmetric HG layer per factor module, identity edge weights, no HG bias/dropout, LeakyReLU slope 0.01, projection 32->32->32 with both activations.
notes.data_assumptions: History includes signal day; future starts next trading day and uses future-window last close; volume mean uses valid observations within each branch; missing-window threshold 20%.
notes.clipping_assumptions: Per-fold 0.1%/99.9% quantiles of normalized training-anchor windows. Exact when count fits reservoir; otherwise seeded uniform priority-reservoir estimate, capped at 200000 values per feature.
notes.training_assumptions: One full date cross-section per step, two-year rolling stride, strict 21-day train/valid target purge, early stopping on mean four-horizon validation IC with 20 epoch checks.
notes.missing_data_assumptions: Predictor stocks selected using current/history only; targets are masked. Future branch keeps historical graph nodes and fills unavailable inputs with zero; CL uses valid matched pairs only.
notes.masked_mse_assumption: Guide section 5.5: average valid target elements; with unequal missing-label counts horizon weights vary. No targets are filled as observed zero.
notes.runtime_assumption: Windows only: MKL_THREADING_LAYER defaults to SEQUENTIAL to avoid local Anaconda OpenMP collision; Linux is unchanged. DataLoader workers=0; float32; no AMP.
notes.scope: Unofficial independent A-share baseline replication, seed 42 only, two rolling folds. All numeric training/model/data settings match the archived run.
notes.price_data: Forward-adjusted A-share daily OHLC and volume. VWAP reconstructed from same-date four-OHLC common factor and old unadjusted volume; source turnover matches. Factor is estimated within rounding intervals, not supplier-provided.
notes.scaler: Fit new per-fold training scalers from new data; do not load old scaler/model weights.

baseline_protocol.change: all root seeds 42: initialization, date shuffle, Python/NumPy/PyTorch/CUDA and scaler reservoir
